text:
Sailor without land,
shipwrecked man without sails,
orphan without a harbor,
ship without a helm.

Surrounded by water and thirsty,
surrounded by fish and hungry,
surrounded by waves and no greetings,
surrounded by dollars and naked.

translation.title: Sailor Without Land...
translation.editorial_note:
Direct translation; no separate editorial review was conducted.
